# Yala Park Safari

> Private and shared jeep safaris in Yala National Park, Sri Lanka

## About

Yala Park Safari is an independent safari operator based near Yala National Park in southern Sri Lanka. We offer three safari experiences: Full-Day Private Safari, Half-Day Private Safari, and Shared Safari. All bookings are handled directly via WhatsApp.

## Safari Experiences

### Full-Day Private Safari
A full day in Yala National Park with your own jeep and group, giving you time to explore further and wait patiently at quieter spots. Private jeep for up to 6 guests with a dedicated driver for the day.

### Half-Day Private Safari
A morning or afternoon game drive in your own jeep — a relaxed way to see Yala if you have a shorter schedule. Private jeep for up to 6 guests.

### Shared Safari
Join other travellers in a shared jeep for a half-day drive. A good choice for solo travellers and couples on a budget. Available in morning or afternoon sessions.

## Location

Yala National Park area, Southern Province, Sri Lanka
